input.summary: Extend the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocation at Vendor's discretion
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Services licence in 13.1 to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and removed revocation at Vendor's sole discretion so that revocation is governed by the uncured material breach standard already agreed in 13.3. Our playbook requires affiliate and contractor coverage and no at-will revocation; if helpful, we can instead cover Affiliates on written notice to Vendor.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer and its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf, a licence to use the Services, transferable as provided in Section 13.3 and revocable or suspendable only as provided in Section 13.3.
